_readme: Per-session resolutions for the ambiguous speaker labels in authors.json (owner ruling CONTRACTS §8a.2).
QUOTE-FREE BY DESIGN. This repository is public. Nothing here carries transcript text, Discord message text,
a price, a share count or any position detail. Evidence is cited by IDENTIFIER only: an edu_videos cue second,
a discord:<channel_id>:<message_id>, or a substack section path.
THE RULE (§8a.2). A label listed in authors.json `ambiguous_speaker_labels` is NOT an alias of anybody.
It resolves for ONE session at a time, and only on one of the four named evidence kinds:
A session with no entry here resolves to 'team-unresolved', which may author MENTION only — never a CALL,
never a PRINCIPLE attribution. Never default to tsdr or bracco. Never resolve by voice similarity.
⚠️ KNOWN LIMIT, recorded so it is not discovered as a surprise: the unit of resolution is the SESSION, which is
what the ruling says. A shared host account can hand over mid-session (edu_videos 332 is a measured example),
so a session resolution can be NARROWED later by adding `from_cue_t_s` / `to_cue_t_s` to an entry. Narrowing is
a safe change; widening one is not.
⛔ An owner ruling on a SPECIFIC RECORD beats a session resolution. Two records carry one: golden G-035 and
G-052, where the owner answered 'unknown' at checkpoint 2 (items 007 and 008). They are team-unresolved BY
RULING and are never re-derived from the session entries below.
ruling: CONTRACTS §8a.2 (checkpoint 1) + §8b.2 (the data change and its code path ship together)
